# Croom Petty Sessions Order Book — 26 April 1869

**NAI series:** CSPS1/8383 (Petty Sessions Order Books, Co. Limerick)
**Source:** FamilySearch, "Croom, County Limerick, Ireland records," images
**URL:** https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:33S7-9BS1-9W44?view=fullText
**Image:** 150 of 829
**Image Group Number:** 005174405

## Court details

- **Date:** 26 April 1869
- **Justices:** Edwd J. Smith + Defernon (?)
- **Complainant (across multiple cases):** Constable John Flynn, Croom

## Charge pattern

Mass dog-license enforcement sweep. Multiple defendants charged the same day:
"Having one day in his possession [a dog] without License."

## Orders

Same disposition for each defendant — pleaded guilty, fined 1 penny + costs (the "pence" / "opence" rendering in the transcript), ordered to take out a dog license.

## Why this matters for the Gleeson research

1. **Patrick Gleeson at Scagh confirmed in 1869** — extending documented residency from 14 Jun 1864 (last Petty Sessions appearance prior to this) by five years. Continuous presence: 1859 → 1864 → 1869.
2. **Patrick Moloney of Anhid in the same session** — already a recurring Croom-baptism Moloney sponsor; Anhid is a real townland near Croom. Strong candidate for one of Margaret's brothers, now placed in the same Petty Sessions as Patrick Gleeson on the same day.
3. **Scagh-cluster neighbors listed** — Boherard, Ballintaw, Manister, Toureen, Corrobill, Hullar, Pollough, Dohora, Dullas — useful map of the Croom parish neighborhood where Patrick was socially embedded.
4. **Justice Edwd J. Smith** — a different magistrate than the Robert Maxwell + C. J. Collins / Henry Lyons combinations seen in 1859 and 1864. Suggests a rotation of justices at Croom Petty Sessions across the 1860s.

## Raw transcript

(As supplied by user, lightly reformatted from OCR text — original images on FamilySearch)

> No. 4 Date of Order 1869 April 26 ... Name or Names of Justice or Justices by whom Order made: Edwd J. Smith Defernon ... PARTIES — COMPLAINANT AND DEFENDANT: Constable John Flynn Croom (Compt) ... James McCarty Pollough (Deft), John Griffin (Deg), Michael Liston Dullas (Deft), Nicolas Fox Dohora, Patrick Dalton Boherard, Patrick Quard Ballintaw, Denis Slater Manister, John Braycherduff, Thomas McNamara Toureen, Thos Lynch, Willas, Patt Molony Anded, Maurice Hayes, John Kiely Corrobill, Jeremiah Carman, Patrick Gleeson Scough, Bridget Maskell Hullar — all Defts ... CAUSE OF COMPLAINT: Having one day in his possession [dog] 26 April 1869 without License ... PARTICULARS OF ORDER: said one penny and pence costs and to take out license / same Rule (repeated for each)

## Implications for next research moves

- Pulling **Patrick Moloney of Anhid** as a focused Margaret-brother candidate is now well-supported. Worth searching Croom register for: (a) Patrick Moloney of Anhid's own marriage; (b) any of his children's baptisms; (c) his appearance as sponsor at our Patrick + Margaret's children's events.
- **A systematic FamilySearch Petty Sessions sweep** for "Gleeson" + "Croom" 1859–1900 is now indicated as a research workflow. The 1869 record was a single image find; many more likely exist.
